title: vaultsyncd durable backup export receipt v1
description: Owner-only 0600 sidecar <archive>.verification.json. exported_unverified records fsynced export; only explicit offline verify rereads every item before verified. Missing, corrupt or canceled exports stay incomplete. VSBK001 archive is magic VSBK001\n (8 bytes), big-endian u64 manifest length (1..268435456), exact pinned manifest bytes, items ordered by UTF-8 path: big-endian u32 path length, path UTF-8, big-endian u64 content length, exact content. Final u32 zero is emitted only after every manifest item hashes successfully. The manifest fixes all paths, lengths and hashes; no arbitrary or duplicate entries. Each streaming buffer is at most 65536 bytes excluding bounded manifest. Neither ready nor source verified implies a durable client export.
